svg.title: Request pipeline: where every response comes from
svg.desc: A request passes five stages in order: 1 express.json, 2 tenantMiddleware, 3 employeeRoutes, 4 service.ts, 5 repository.ts and PostgreSQL. Success responses (200 or 201) are sent by the route handler. Each stage can instead throw: 1 gives 400 INVALID_JSON or 413; 2 gives 401 UNAUTHENTICATED; 3 gives 400 VALIDATION_ERROR or 404 EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND for a non-UUID id, and unmatched routes get 404 NOT_FOUND from notFoundHandler; 4 gives 404 EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND, 409 ALREADY_CONFIRMED or 422 MAX_PROBATION_EXCEEDED; 5 gives database backstops 422 CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION and 400, or 500 INTERNAL_ERROR. All thrown errors go through errorHandler. Writes run in a transaction, so a rejected request leaves no change and no audit row.
svg.text: Request pipeline: where every response comes from
createApp() in src/app.ts mounts these stages in order. Each one passes the request on or throws; the numbers tie every outcome to its stage.
2xx JSON, sent by the route handler: 201 for create and extend, 200 otherwise
(src/error-handler.ts): the one place a thrown error becomes a response, always { error: { code, message, details? } }
Database backstops and 500s are logged with the Postgres code, constraint and table; the client only gets the generic message.
On a write these run inside withTransaction (src/db.ts): any throw → ROLLBACK, so a rejected request changes nothing and writes no audit row.
dashed: database backstop, unreachable if the app is correct
